what: Inside a section as long as the slot count × one screen length, the stage sticks to the screen, and for each slot (the scrolled fraction divided by the slot count) the text, the visual layer and the side-rail link change together — the old text and layer vanish in .4s and the new text rises from 20px below over .4s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) while the new visual layer (gradient panel·screen card) appears overlapping. The rail link lights up for the current slot, and clicking it scrolls to that slot. Suited to a product landing that shows five features one after another in one spot

options.rise: Distance (px) new text rises from, default 20 — 0 overlaps in place
options.start / end: Scroll range that divides the cells (ScrollTrigger), default top top · bottom bottom
options.--fx-per: Scroll length of one cell (css variable), default 100svh
options.--fx-top: Where the stage attaches (css variable, fixed header height), default 0
options.[data-fx-part=steps] > [data-fx-part=ste: Text in each cell — stacked in one spot
options.[data-fx-part=layers] > [data-fx-part=la: Image layers per cell (optional). Give the cell index (from 0) via data-key to stack several layers in one cell
options.[data-fx-part=link]: Side rail links (optional) — in slot order
